likeness_reference: A cropped photo of the site's author (only his own face), used as an image reference for the reader on the couch. Not stored in the repository.
rejected_alternative: nano_banana_2 with the same prompt: angled bookshelf, harder to overlay interactive volumes.
pixelation: python3 scripts/pixelate_room.py — 16:9 crop, box downscale to 320x180, contrast 1.05, 64-colour median cut with 3 k-means passes, no dithering. Reproduces the shipped PNG exactly.
prompt:
Cozy indie pixel art scene, 16:9, crisp 16-bit pixel art with big visible square pixels, like a 320x180 game screen scaled up. Limited mellow palette, no anti-aliasing, no text, no letters, no UI.

A small cozy reading room at night, seen straight-on from the front like a side-view 2D game interior. Mellow lo-fi mood: dusky indigo and plum shadows with warm amber lamplight.

Left 40% of the frame: a tall built-in wooden bookshelf from floor to ceiling with three long horizontal shelves. The shelves are EMPTY, only a dark wood back panel, plus one tiny plant on the top.

Center-right: a large window with rain streaks showing a rainy night sky, soft distant city lights and a far-away clock tower silhouette. Under the window: a soft, slightly worn mustard-orange couch with cushions and a knitted blanket.

On the couch: the young man from the reference photo as a pixel art character, same curly black hair and skin tone, wearing round glasses, a black puffer jacket over a grey hoodie, dark pants, sitting cross-legged and calmly reading an open book held in both hands.

Next to him on the couch: an orange tabby cat curled up asleep.

Right side: a floor lamp with a warm glow, a small side table with a steaming mug, a potted monstera, string fairy lights along the top of the wall, a round woven rug on a wooden floor.

Style: Coffee Talk, Eastward, A Short Hike, lofi pixel art rooms. Clean readable silhouettes, dithered soft lighting, calm and cozy.
